question: europe: one json doc per country embedding its admin-0 capitals as structs sorted by population desc
sql:
WITH caps AS (
  SELECT name, admin1, pop_max, geometry
  FROM populated_places
  WHERE feature_class = 'Admin-0 capital'
)
SELECT c.iso_a3, c.name,
       to_json(list(struct_pack(place := caps.name,
                                admin1 := caps.admin1,
                                pop_max := caps.pop_max)
                    ORDER BY caps.pop_max DESC, caps.name)) AS capitals_json
FROM countries c
JOIN caps ON ST_Within(caps.geometry, c.geometry)
WHERE c.continent = 'Europe'
GROUP BY c.iso_a3, c.name
ORDER BY c.name;

question: emerging g20 economies: explode per-country admin-1 capital struct lists, keep the place farthest from the country centroid in km
sql:
WITH g20 AS (
  SELECT iso_a3, name, geometry
  FROM countries
  WHERE economy = '5. Emerging region: G20'
),
packed AS (
  SELECT g.iso_a3, g.name,
         ST_Centroid(g.geometry) AS cpt,
         list(struct_pack(place := p.name, admin1 := p.admin1, pt := p.geometry)
              ORDER BY p.name) AS places
  FROM g20 g
  JOIN populated_places p
    ON p.feature_class = 'Admin-1 capital'
   AND ST_Within(p.geometry, g.geometry)
  GROUP BY g.iso_a3, g.name, ST_Centroid(g.geometry)
),
exploded AS (
  SELECT iso_a3, name, cpt, unnest(places) AS s
  FROM packed
)
SELECT iso_a3, name, s.place AS place,
       round(ST_Distance_Spheroid(s.pt, cpt) / 1000.0, 1) AS dist_km
FROM exploded
QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY iso_a3
                           ORDER BY ST_Distance_Spheroid(s.pt, cpt) DESC, s.place) = 1
ORDER BY dist_km DESC, iso_a3;

question: countries whose median admin-1 capital population is under 500000, capitals returned as a json array ordered by population
sql:
WITH packed AS (
  SELECT c.iso_a3, c.name,
         list(p.pop_max ORDER BY p.pop_max) AS pops,
         list(p.name ORDER BY p.pop_max, p.name) AS places
  FROM countries c
  JOIN populated_places p
    ON p.feature_class = 'Admin-1 capital'
   AND ST_Within(p.geometry, c.geometry)
  GROUP BY c.iso_a3, c.name
)
SELECT iso_a3, name,
       list_aggregate(pops, 'median') AS median_capital_pop,
       to_json(places) AS places_json
FROM packed
WHERE list_aggregate(pops, 'median') < 500000
ORDER BY median_capital_pop DESC, iso_a3;

question: world cities per continent as sorted lists, exploded with alphabetical rank, first three per continent only
sql:
WITH world AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT c.continent, p.name
  FROM countries c
  JOIN populated_places p
    ON p.is_world_city
   AND ST_Within(p.geometry, c.geometry)
),
packed AS (
  SELECT continent, list(name ORDER BY name) AS cities
  FROM world
  GROUP BY continent
),
exploded AS (
  SELECT continent, cities, unnest(cities) AS city
  FROM packed
)
SELECT continent, list_position(cities, city) AS alpha_rank, city
FROM exploded
WHERE list_position(cities, city) <= 3
ORDER BY continent, alpha_rank;

question: top 3 largest countries per continent by spheroid area, packed as a json struct list per continent
sql:
WITH sized AS (
  SELECT continent, iso_a3, name,
         round(ST_Area_Spheroid(geometry) / 1000000.0, 0) AS area_km2
  FROM countries
  WHERE continent NOT IN ('Antarctica', 'Seven seas (open ocean)')
),
packed AS (
  SELECT continent,
         (list(struct_pack(iso := iso_a3, name := name, area_km2 := area_km2)
               ORDER BY area_km2 DESC, iso_a3))[1:3] AS top3
  FROM sized
  GROUP BY continent
)
SELECT continent, to_json(top3) AS top3_json
FROM packed
ORDER BY continent;

question: one json doc of places within 800km of -23.5167 14.9167 (Praia), each a struct with distance in km, sorted nearest first
sql:
WITH origin AS (
  SELECT ST_Point(-23.5167, 14.9167) AS pt
),
near AS (
  SELECT p.name, p.country, p.feature_class, p.pop_max,
         round(ST_Distance_Spheroid(p.geometry, o.pt) / 1000.0, 1) AS dist_km
  FROM populated_places p, origin o
  WHERE p.name <> 'Praia'
    AND ST_DWithin_Spheroid(p.geometry, o.pt, 800000)
)
SELECT to_json(struct_pack(
         n := count(*),
         places := list(struct_pack(place := name,
                                    country := country,
                                    feature_class := feature_class,
                                    dist_km := dist_km)
                        ORDER BY dist_km, name)
       )) AS result
FROM near;
